[[File:Razor_net.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Imperial agent [[Jeffren Brek]] using a net gun.]]
A '''net gun''' or '''net launcher'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a device that fired compressed nets, either chemical or fiber based.

Chemical-based net guns sprayed out a net of a sticky substance, similar in fashion to [[Spray stick/Legends|Stokhli spray sticks]]. These chemical-based net guns could be deployed handheld or on a walker, like on [[All Terrain Kashyyyk Transport]]s.

Fiber-based net guns, such as the [[Conner Ship Systems]] [[APNG3]] or the [[Razor net]], fired a compressed fiber net, which was capable of capturing targets lethally or nonlethally.

[[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] manufactured two speciality net launchers designed to fire canisters packed with [[Stun net/Legends|stun nets]]; the [[RL-40 stun net launcher]] and the [[RGL-80A electronet grenade launcher]].<ref name="EGWT" />
